about: RO1 reference, NOT client evidence (inferred, docs/research/world-core-evidence.md). The server makes a field monster attack on sight when its NPCConfig _iAI is 20000004 (MonsterService.AggressiveAi); with the switch Ro3Emu:Ro1AggressiveMonsters on, the monsters below attack on sight too because their Ragnarok Online 1 counterpart does. Sources (rAthena master, fetched 2026-10-28): pre-renewal monster database https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rathena/rathena/master/db/pre-re/mob_db.yml, mode reference https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rathena/rathena/master/doc/mob_db_mode_list.txt, permanent spawn scripts https://github.com/rathena/rathena/tree/master/npc/pre-re/mobs (fields/, dungeons/, citycleaners.txt) and https://github.com/rathena/rathena/tree/master/npc/mobs; for comparison and for monsters absent from pre-renewal, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rathena/rathena/master/db/re/mob_db.yml and https://github.com/rathena/rathena/tree/master/npc/re/mobs. A RO1 monster is aggressive when its mode has MD_AGGRESSIVE (0x4): the Aegis Ai type gives the base mode (aggressive types 04, 05, 08, 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, 19, 20, 21, 26, 27; a missing Ai is 06), then Class and Modes add or clear bits (no pre-renewal entry sets or clears Aggressive through Modes). ro1Flags also records MD_ASSIST (joins a same-class monster that attacks), MD_LOOTER, cast sensor (0x10/0x200), change target (0x400/0x1000/0x2000), Class Boss and MVP. Field monsters are NPCConfig rows with _iNPCType 1 that a scene editor spawns (m_kWorldMonsterSpawnPoints m_kConfigIds / m_kWorldMonsterSpawnGroups m_kMonsterRefreshLimitDatas) or that have _iWildMonsters 1: 223 rows; ro3.scenes lists the scenes that spawn each (the 4940xxx rows spawn only in gvg_lingtuzhan_* scenes). Bosses and elites are included (owner's decision: Maya and other MVPs as in RO1). Which RO1 entry is the monster: among the rAthena entries with the RO3 English name (NPCConfig _kName in Localization_en), the one that a pre-renewal field or dungeon spawn script places; variant copies (G_, EVENT_, E_, META_, R_, A_, M_, summons) are excluded because no spawn script places them, not because of their prefix. Where several entries of a name spawn (Goblin, Kobold, Picky, Petite, Whisper) or the RO3 name is a variant, the entry is chosen by the RO3 model / head icon, the RO3 Chinese name, element, and RO1 drops; `match` names the method and `why` the evidence. Race/element/size are cross-checked for the 5000xxx rows (the 4940xxx copies carry rescaled attributes); differences are noted in `why`. Four RO3 monsters (King Dramoh, Sropho, Pot Dofle, Squidgitte = Sedora) exist only in the renewal database and are judged from it. Renewal disagrees with pre-renewal on two listed monsters (Familiar 1005 and Scorpion 1001 are Ai 01, passive, in renewal); pre-renewal is used. Counts: 140 aggressive (monsters), 83 matched but not aggressive in RO1 (notAggressive), 0 unmatched. Never mixed into client data.
